title: A Posterior Model Projection of Narrow-domain ExoEarth Candidates in the Milky Way's 7--9 kpc Annulus
description: Audited manuscript v4 and compact reproducibility archive for a conditional ExoEarth population projection. The exact nominal DR25 target contains zero candidates and zero summed reliability; the reported posterior intervals are conditional model projections and not direct candidate-supported occurrence measurements.
notes: Draft metadata only. Do not publish until the GitHub draft release, PDF preflight, and release audit are complete.
